reason: OPEN: Lacey section 7.1 including (7.11) was read in full. The source invokes Calderon-Zygmund theory without proving the localized signed-tree estimate. The present statement also needs explicit localization weight, input class, threshold, modulation and constant quantifiers. Plancherel and the ball maximal inequality do not supply a uniform weak (1,1) bound for signed packet projections. Proposed local supplier: a modulated Calderon-Zygmund decomposition with uniform packet-kernel size, cancellation and smoothness estimates, proving the exact weighted version needed in (7.11). This is substantial unmet mathematics, not an accepted reference.
